serialization: native C ABI byte slice, size_t length, and uint32_t output
ownership: Go caller retains input and output storage for the duration of the synchronous call; C allocates nothing
nullability: empty Go slices are rejected before pointer conversion; C rejects null input and output pointers
endianness: ASCII decimal conversion is endian independent; uint32_t is returned by value through the declared ABI
alignment: C compiler alignment for uint32_t output; generated cgo declaration is identity bound
containment: no callbacks, panic, exception, longjmp, or unwind may cross the ABI
timeout: one call is bounded to at most six input bytes and has no internal blocking operation
cancellation: cancellation is checked by the Go host between calls; a single bounded parse call is not interruptible
retry: retry is allowed only with a corrected immutable input frame
version_negotiation: exact MNCS_PARSER_ABI value and exact generated binding/header/spec identities
malformed_input: empty, null, nondecimal, oversized, and out-of-range frames reject
compatibility_policy: byte-for-byte regenerated Go binding after gofmt plus exact source-header and binding-spec hashes
unknown_conditions: compiler ABI outside declared hosted environments
